name: Wise
label: Wise — Wise Platform API
description: Official Wise Platform API. Docs: https://docs.wise.com. One node; operations via `operation`. SCA and sanctions screening are Wise’s. StudioQuack does not custody funds. Sandbox: api.wise-sandbox.com (V1 api.sandbox.transferwise.tech retired 2026-06-30). Deprecated: balance_list GET /v1/borderless-accounts — use balances_list GET /v4/profiles/{profileId}/balances (types=STANDARD,SAVINGS). Deprecated: statement_get borderless-accounts/.../statement.json — use balance_statement_get GET /v1/profiles/{profileId}/balance-statements/{balanceId}/statement.json. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Wise. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: balance_list | balances_list | currency_list | statement_get | balance_statement_get | rate_get | profile_get | profile_list | recipient_list | quote_create | quote_get | transfer_create | transfer_get | transfer_list | transfer_delete | transfer_execute | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: profileId
schema.description: URL path/query-string parameter `profileId` for operations: balance_list, balances_list, statement_get, balance_statement_get, profile_get, recipient_list, quote_create, quote_get, transfer_list, transfer_execute. Required by: balances_list, statement_get, balance_statement_get, profile_get, quote_create, quote_get, transfer_execute.

schema.label: accountId
schema.description: URL path parameter `accountId` for operation: statement_get. Required by: statement_get.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: Query-string parameter `currency` for operations: statement_get, balance_statement_get.

schema.label: intervalStart
schema.description: Query-string parameter `intervalStart` for operations: statement_get, balance_statement_get.

schema.label: intervalEnd
schema.description: Query-string parameter `intervalEnd` for operations: statement_get, balance_statement_get.

schema.label: balanceId
schema.description: URL path parameter `balanceId` for operation: balance_statement_get. Required by: balance_statement_get.

schema.label: quoteId
schema.description: URL path parameter `quoteId` for operation: quote_get. Required by: quote_get.

schema.label: transferId
schema.description: URL path parameter `transferId` for operations: transfer_get, transfer_delete, transfer_execute. Required by: transfer_get, transfer_delete, transfer_execute.

schema.label: environment
schema.description: API host environment. EXACT: sandbox | production. sandbox→api.wise-sandbox.com; production→api.wise.com. Example: sandbox.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: balance_list | balances_list | currency_list | statement_get | balance_statement_get | rate_get | profile_get | profile_list | recipient_list | quote_create | quote_get | transfer_create | transfer_get | transfer_list | transfer_delete | transfer_execute | trigger. Default balance_list. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Wise credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: api.wise-sandbox.com (sandbox) vs api.wise.com (production). Select host environment; set matching api_token.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
